clue.text: Tennis stroke bringing advantage

definitions.meaning: a shot played with the palm facing forward
an older sense of the word is a superior position or upper hand over someone

explanation.surface: A tennis player's best shot wins them the point.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the palm-forward racket shot and, in an older usage, a position of superiority or the upper hand.

clue.text: See 24
Journey over lake reveals rubbish

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sitting over another means it comes first in the column

parts.note: a drive is a journey by car
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A trip past a lake turns out to be a waste of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: silly, meaningless talk is nonsense or rubbish.

clue.text: Conciliator to pop up around the Home Counties

indicators.note: the verb for popping up wraps itself around the abbreviation for the region

parts.note: to appear is to pop up suddenly
the Home Counties are the counties surrounding London in South-East England, hence SE

explanation.surface: A peacemaker briefly turns up in the commuter belt around London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties around London, in the South East of England, abbreviated SE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who placates or pacifies others is a conciliator.

clue.text: Restlessness evident in self-identification of G&S character

parts.note: a character introducing herself says 'I'm', giving IM
Patience is the title heroine of the Gilbert and Sullivan operetta Patience

explanation.surface: An actor in a Gilbert and Sullivan role seems fidgety when announcing who she is.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as the heroine of Gilbert and Sullivan's Patience introducing herself: "I'm Patience".
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being unable to wait calmly is restlessness.

clue.text: Rob's warm garment

definitions.meaning: to swindle or overcharge someone, to take their money
a cosy jacket or top of soft synthetic pile

explanation.surface: A thief's cosy jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for swindling someone out of money and a cosy pile jacket.

clue.text: Talk from head of college about poetry

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, so only the first letter of college is used

parts.note: on means about, concerning
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A college principal gives a lecture on poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to converse is to chat or hold a conversation.

clue.text: Reprimand that comes with the bashing of drum?

definitions.text: that comes with the bashing of drum?
definitions.meaning: a loud blast of sound battering the eardrum is a fill of the ear

explanation.surface: A drummer's neighbours complain about the noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a long angry scolding, and literally an ear filled with sound when the eardrum is pounded.

clue.text: Tree providing fruit, no end, east of river

indicators.note: in an across clue, east of means placed to the right, after

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river

indicators.note: the fruit word loses its final letter

parts.note: a melon is a fruit

explanation.surface: A tree yields fruit, with the orchard lying east of a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the citrus tree that bears the large grapefruit-like fruit of that name.

clue.text: Busy type, awfully smart — they'll get put down in the pub

definitions.text: they'll get put down in the pub

parts.note: a bee is proverbially busy

indicators.note: awfully signals that the letters of smart are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: A hard-working, sharply dressed person is told off by drinkers in a bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Busy type' looks like a description of a person; it is the proverbially busy insect. The definition describes the cardboard coasters set under pints.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: small cardboard coasters that pub drinkers set their glasses on.

clue.text: Adds different colours to very small sign around entrance

parts.note: very in small, abbreviated form is V

indicators.note: the zodiac sign is wrapped around the word for entrance

parts.note: Aries is a sign of the zodiac
a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: A painter puts colour around a doorway with a tiny marking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'very small' means the abbreviated form of very, V.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to mark with patches of differing hues is to give something various colours.

clue.text: Composer among rich and elegant characters

indicators.note: the letters sit among the characters of the following words, spanning their joins

explanation.surface: A composer mixing with wealthy and stylish people.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: George Frideric, the German-born Baroque composer of Messiah.

clue.text: Naughty Sal I beheld in a state of undress

indicators.note: naughty suggests misbehaving letters, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: A peeping confession: someone saw cheeky Sal without her clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Loanword from French: being only partly or carelessly dressed is a state of undress.

clue.text: Not appropriate to be wearing informal attire?

definitions.meaning: jokingly, not dressed in a suit, so casually clad

explanation.surface: Turning up in casual clothes is not the done thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: unfit or ill-matched, and humorously, someone not dressed in a formal suit.

clue.text: Cook with herb — a specified health-giving amount?

parts.note: to do food is to cook it
sage is a herb

explanation.surface: A recipe telling you to cook with a herb, in a measured healthy quantity.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a prescribed quantity of medicine to be taken at one time.

clue.text: Soldier on the ball having accepted top-class advice

indicators.note: in a down clue, the soldier part sits on top of the dance word
the soldier takes in the letter for top-class

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
U means upper-class, top-class
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A soldier on the dance floor, having taken on board some top-class tips.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class is a long-standing British label for posh usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: counsel or direction given to help someone is advice.

clue.text: Swimming gear in luggage

explanation.surface: Swimwear packed in a suitcase.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both men's swimming shorts and large chests used as luggage.

clue.text: Team getting cross, upset, making emergency exit?

parts.note: a side is a team

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word for cross upside down, reading upwards

parts.note: a rood is a cross, especially a crucifix in a church

explanation.surface: A team gets angry and upset, prompting an escape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like an adjective for angry; it is the noun ROOD, which 'upset' turns to DOOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an entrance at the side of a building is a secondary way out in a crisis.

clue.text: This person leading the side is crying

indicators.note: in a down clue, this piece comes first, ahead of the other

parts.note: the setter refers to themselves, so me
a wing is a side, as of a building or army

explanation.surface: A captain at the front of the team is in tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: making a feeble crying sound like a cat or gull.

clue.text: Instrument is one not working — engineer needed

parts.note: an organ is a musical instrument

indicators.note: not tells us to remove the letters for working from the word one

parts.note: the word one, taken as written
on means working, operating

explanation.surface: A broken instrument needs an engineer to fix it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes ON from ONE, leaving E. 'engineer' looks like the person needed; it is the verb, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to engineer something is to arrange or bring it about.

clue.text: Feline once caught rodent outside

indicators.note: the rodent goes outside the other letters

parts.note: a rat is a rodent
ex means former, once
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A cat that once trapped a rat.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rex is a breed of curly-coated cat.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a curly-coated domestic breed is a kind of feline.

clue.text: Areas of interest for comic actor

definitions.meaning: W. C. ..., the American comedian and film actor

explanation.surface: A comedian's favourite subjects.
explanation.definitionFit: Both subject areas of study, and the surname of the American comedian W. C. Fields.

clue.text: Knight gets irritable going around in splendour

indicators.note: the hot-tempered word goes around the knight's letter

parts.note: fiery means hot-tempered, irritable
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A tetchy knight paces about dressed in his best.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: showy, elaborate clothes and decoration amount to splendour.

clue.text: Fervour of old lover getting recognition

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
a citation is an official mention recognising someone's achievement

explanation.surface: A former partner gets an award and is thrilled about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a state of being stirred up or aroused is fervour.

clue.text: Crazy English sweetheart heading off to be given new look

parts.note: mad means crazy

indicators.note: the word for sweetheart loses its first letter

parts.note: a lover is a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A wild Englishman's sweetheart is off for a makeover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' removes the L of LOVER, giving OVER.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: something made over has been restyled or transformed in appearance.

clue.text: See 10
French in charge? There's bitterness to begin with

indicators.note: the bitterness piece is placed first, before the other

parts.note: gall is bitterness, rancour

explanation.surface: A French official in charge shows resentment from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: relating to France or the French, from the Latin for Gaul.

clue.text: Twist that surprisingly brings Tory gain

indicators.note: a surprising result is one turned around unexpectedly, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An election swing where the Conservatives unexpectedly pick up seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a whirling or rotating movement is a twist or spin.
